keywords_en: a Hegotá set of four for native private transactions
Kohaku access layer security and privacy
summary_en: yoavw submitted the PR moving ERC-4337 to Final. soispoke argued that if Hegotá ships FOCIL (EIP-7805), frame transactions (EIP-8141), keyed nonces (EIP-8250) and recent roots (EIP-8272), Ethereum gets native, trustless, censorship resistant private transactions next year. Vitalik described Kohaku's goal of security and read and write privacy at the access layer. L2BEAT released its privacy page.
